definition.description: Run once at install, and again after any upgrade that adds a column. Lists the available Outlook and Google calendars, provisions the three state lists with their indexed columns, seeds one health row per monitored flow with that flow's own staleness threshold, and emails a configuration summary. Idempotent: every create tolerates 'already exists', and retries are disabled on those so a re-run takes seconds rather than minutes.

List_Outlook_Calendars.description: Shows which calendar IDs are valid for OutlookCalendarId.

List_Google_Calendars.description: Shows which calendar IDs are valid for GoogleCalendarId.

parameters.parameters/body: @setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(json('{}'), 'BaseTemplate', 100), 'Title', 'O365GCalSyncMap'), 'Description', 'Correlates each mirrored Outlook occurrence to its Google event. Source of truth for what this automation created, and therefore for what it is allowed to delete.'), 'ContentTypesEnabled', false)

Create_List_SyncMap.description: Creates O365GCalSyncMap, tolerating 'already exists' - the normal case from the second run onward. Retries are off because that failure is expected.

Add_SyncMap_OutlookEventId.description: Current Graph event id. Changes when an invitation is accepted, which is exactly why it is not the correlation key.

Add_SyncMap_OutlookICalUId.description: Stable across the id rewrite and shared by every occurrence of a series.

Add_SyncMap_OccurrenceStartUtc.description: Drives the in-window filter so out-of-window rows are never mistaken for deletions.

Add_SyncMap_GoogleEventId.description: Empty means nothing to delete. We only ever delete an id we recorded ourselves.

Add_SyncMap_ContentFingerprint.description: Change detection. A plain comparable string rather than a hash, because the Power Automate expression language has no hashing function.

Index_SyncMap_OutlookICalUId.description: Indexed: filtered on every run, and SharePoint refuses unindexed filters past 5000 items.

Index_SyncMap_OccurrenceStartUtc.description: Indexed: filtered on every run, and SharePoint refuses unindexed filters past 5000 items.

Index_SyncMap_SyncState.description: Indexed: filtered on every run, and SharePoint refuses unindexed filters past 5000 items.

Index_SyncMap_Title.description: Title carries the correlation key, the run id or the flow name; every lookup filters on it.

Create_List_Log.description: Creates O365GCalLog, tolerating 'already exists' - the normal case from the second run onward. Retries are off because that failure is expected.

Index_Log_Timestamp.description: Indexed: filtered on every run, and SharePoint refuses unindexed filters past 5000 items.

Index_Log_Level.description: Indexed: filtered on every run, and SharePoint refuses unindexed filters past 5000 items.

Index_Log_CorrelationKey.description: Indexed: filtered on every run, and SharePoint refuses unindexed filters past 5000 items.

Index_Log_Title.description: Title carries the correlation key, the run id or the flow name; every lookup filters on it.

parameters.parameters/body: @setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(setProperty(json('{}'), 'BaseTemplate', 100), 'Title', 'O365GCalHealth'), 'Description', 'One row per flow. The watchdog reads this; a stale row is how an expired connection or a switched-off flow gets noticed, neither of which any in-flow error handler can catch.'), 'ContentTypesEnabled', false)

Create_List_Health.description: Creates O365GCalHealth, tolerating 'already exists' - the normal case from the second run onward. Retries are off because that failure is expected.

Add_Health_StaleAfterMinutes.description: Per-flow staleness threshold. A single global value marks a daily flow as broken for most of every day.

Add_Health_AffectsSync.description: yes only for the reconciler. Determines whether an alert may claim the calendar is going stale.

Index_Health_Title.description: Title carries the correlation key, the run id or the flow name; every lookup filters on it.

Get_Existing_Health.description: Health rows are replaced wholesale rather than updated in place. An upsert keyed on Title cannot remove the duplicates an earlier insert-only version left behind, and a duplicate row carrying no threshold is exactly what raised false alarms.

Remove_All_Health_Rows.description: Clears the list so seeding cannot duplicate. Heartbeat history is reset, which is acceptable: setup is an explicit act, and every monitored flow rewrites its row within one cycle.

Seed_Health_Rows.description: One row per monitored flow, each carrying its own staleness threshold. A single global threshold marked the daily digest as broken for 22 hours out of every 24.

Create_Health_Row.description: LastSuccessUtc is stamped now so a freshly seeded row is not instantly stale - otherwise setup itself would trigger the alert it exists to make trustworthy.

Google calendar: @{parameters('GoogleCalendarId (o3gc_GoogleCalendarId)')}
Sync window: @{parameters('WindowPastDays (o3gc_WindowPastDays)')} days back to @{parameters('WindowFutureDays (o3gc_WindowFutureDays)')} days ahead
Dry run: @{parameters('DryRun (o3gc_DryRun)')}

Your Outlook calendars
